_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Fanny S. Copeland (1872-1970): Ivana Brlić-Mažuranić's Croatian Tales of Long Ago (1924) and Srđan Tucić's The Slav Nations (1915). Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 33); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator name only: fetch_shelf.py treats it as the identity check, so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
